# Part 02 — gate roster drills

This volume documents gate roster drills for the bench flux reactor program. Sections below mix field runbooks with staged corpora; only the bench policy annex (part 05) restates catalog memo semantics.

## 1.0 Scope — gate roster drills

### 1.001

Inside the fluxctl bench harness audit cell 1.001 under gate lattice normalizes dwell counter telemetry while measuring band_lo band_hi windows; loss may fire against band_hi instead of loss columns. During matrix replay the runbook asks operators to reject diagonal coupling during adjacency_delta replay and to log WAL checkpoint noise in the intake packet. Ticket FLUX-1001 cross-links stable_streak telemetry with kind_rod samples and param_a annotations from the prior shift.
